title: Rational wavefront sets and the descent method for finite classical groups
summary: Let \(\mathbbm{k}\) be a finite field of sufficiently large odd characteristic, let \(F\) be the Frobenius map, and let \(G\) be a symplectic or orthogonal group defined over \(\mathbbm{k}\). For an irreducible representation \(π\) of \(G^F\), its rational wavefront set \(\ScO(π)\) is the set of \(F\)-rational nilpotent orbits \(\mathcal O\) such that \(π\) occurs in the generalized Gelfand--Graev representation \(Γ_{\mathcal O}\).
